prompts.system_role: You are a friendly and knowledgeable health tech enthusiast.
prompts.content_generation:
I need a dual-language post (English and Arabic) about this headline: '{article_title}'.

Structure must be exactly as follows:
English Section:
[Explain the core idea, results, and recommendations naturally in one flow. Keep it engaging and professional.]

---
Arabic Section:
[Explain the same content in clear Arabic. Write it naturally and focus on the result and recommendation.]

Make sure to literally print the text 'English Section:' and 'Arabic Section:' before the respective paragraphs.
prompts.opportunity_generation:
Act as a professional career mentor in the medical field. Write a dual-language LinkedIn post (English and Arabic) about this opportunity:
Role: {title}
Company: {company}
Location: {location}

Structure must be exactly as follows:
English Section:
[Provide a professional hook, mention the role and company, give 2-3 pieces of professional advice or requirements, and end with a call to action. Keep it engaging.]

---
Arabic Section:
[Provide the exact same content translated into clear, professional Arabic. Maintain a professional yet approachable tone.]

Make sure to literally print the text 'English Section:' and 'Arabic Section:' before the respective paragraphs. Do not add any extra bracketed headers (like [القسم الإنجليزي:]).
prompts.conference_generation:
Act as a professional medical career mentor. Write a dual-language LinkedIn post (English and Arabic) about this upcoming medical conference:
Title: {title}
Organizer: {company}
Location: {location}

Structure must be exactly as follows:
English Section:
[Provide a professional hook, describe the conference theme. Write why it is a great opportunity for specialties related to the theme and what they will gain from attending. Mention that the registration link is in the first comment.

Tag relevant universities or institutions involved using @. **CRITICAL: You must place EACH university tag on a separate new line, like a list, so they render correctly on LinkedIn.**]

---
Arabic Section:
[Provide the exact same content translated into clear, professional Arabic. Maintain a professional yet approachable tone. Also include the university tags here with each tag on a separate new line.]

Make sure to literally print the text 'English Section:' and 'Arabic Section:' before the respective paragraphs.
prompts.tool_generation:
Act as a professional academic mentor. Write a dual-language LinkedIn post (English and Arabic) recommending this research tool/database:
Tool Name: {title}
Description: {description}

Structure must be exactly as follows:
English Section:
[Provide an engaging hook about the importance of finding good research. Introduce the tool, explain its main features based on the description, and tell the audience who should use it. End with a question encouraging them to share their favorite tools.]

---
Arabic Section:
[Provide the exact same content translated into clear, professional Arabic.]

Make sure to literally print the text 'English Section:' and 'Arabic Section:' before the respective paragraphs. Do not add any extra bracketed headers.

research_tools.name: Google Scholar
research_tools.description: The most famous and comprehensive academic search engine, covering all disciplines and providing peer-reviewed research, books, and theses.

research_tools.name: Semantic Scholar
research_tools.description: A free AI-powered search engine, excellent for linking research, summarizing results, and finding the most impactful papers in the field.

research_tools.name: ResearchGate
research_tools.description: A social network for researchers where you can search for articles and directly request full-text copies from authors if they are not freely available.

research_tools.name: Cochrane Library
research_tools.description: An essential database for Evidence-Based Medicine research, famous for its comprehensive Systematic Reviews.

research_tools.name: Embase
research_tools.description: A highly powerful biomedicine database, rich in pharmacological and pharmaceutical research.

research_tools.name: CINAHL
research_tools.description: A database specifically dedicated to nursing and allied health professions research.

research_tools.name: ScienceDirect (Elsevier)
research_tools.description: One of the world's largest libraries for scientific, technical, and medical research.

research_tools.name: SpringerLink
research_tools.description: Includes millions of research documents, books, and peer-reviewed scientific journals across various disciplines.

research_tools.name: IEEE Xplore
research_tools.description: Its primary focus is engineering, computer science, and technology related to health tech.

research_tools.name: JSTOR
research_tools.description: Excellent for searching within humanities, social sciences, and history related to medical sociology.
